_how_to_use: Copy to data/theses.json and edit. 'invalidation' rules mark the thesis Broken; 'review' rules mark it Review. Rule types: price_below, trend (Uptrend/Downtrend/Mixed), pl_below (%), weight_above (%), shariah_not (Yes), shariah_is (No), rel_strength_below (points vs S&P 500), insider (Bearish).
